title.fr_fr: Lingot de carburant au Schrabidium faiblement enrichi

content.en_us:
How to get it :
- Crafting table (x2) : 3 x [[gv:billet_les|Low Enriched Schrabidium Fuel Billet]].
- Crafting table : 9 x [[gv:nugget_les|Low Enriched Schrabidium Fuel Nugget]].
- Crafting table : Schrabidium Nugget, 4 x Neptunium Nugget, 4 x [[gv:nugget_beryllium|Beryllium Nugget]].

Used to make :
[[gv:billet_les|Low Enriched Schrabidium Fuel Billet]], [[gv:nugget_les|Low Enriched Schrabidium Fuel Nugget]], [[gv:watz_pellet_les|LES Watz Pellet]].
